title: Two Hamming groups and fourteen wide components with optimized shared-bank roles

claims.statement: The explicit two-Hamming-group hybrid with fourteen wide components and its shortened 40-bit tail, decoded by the allocated shared-table program on 2000 BSC(1/10) uses, has average block error at most 999999999996150600302281906488828977/1000000000000000000000000000000000000.
The same bsc-ops-v1 decoder uses exactly W=191 primitives on every received word and W<=2^(97961/12928).

experiments.purpose: Recompute the wide sector and low-bank minimum-weight pair counts, the zero-byte parity subset, and the exact wide/tail probability product. Sector zero also replays four fixed decoder inputs.
